svg.text: Let me get back to you
A natural way to promise a later answer when
Let me get back to you on that after I have
Get back to someone means respond later.
Add a time if possible and follow through;
without a deadline, it can sound like
A: Can you confirm the final price?
B: Let me get back to you on that by tomorrow
A: Do you need to check the delivery charge?
B: Yes. I will confirm the total before ten.
